//: The import map for the browser bundle. deltic's wasi-shims and the polymorph deltic host modules import @deltic/runtime/embedder by bare specifier internally; mapping it ONCE here means the whole module graph shares one copy, so `instanceof WitError` holds across every boundary. Multiple copies is a real, previously-observed failure mode in this component family (errors stop being recognisable across a module boundary and surface as unbranded throws).
All paths point into .deps/, which scripts/setup.sh pins and builds.
